data.title: 隐德来希 · 散场的眼神
data.description: 人群散去，她回头轻触领口，笑问那句台词是否也让你想起了两人之间的约定。
data.action: 回身倾首，指尖轻搭领口
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: In the opulent, velvet-lined grand foyer of an opera house after the final applause, Entelechia lightly touches the jewel at her collar, glancing back over her shoulder toward the viewer with a conspiratorial, bewitching smile. Enormous crystal chandeliers cast dazzling golden light over marble grand staircases, gilded railings, and the departing, murmuring crowd in the grand hall.
